freezeClaim: Task-local pre-fit protocol declaration that must be frozen by a dedicated repository commit before the final evidence run. Repository content identity is enforced by SHA-256; no external timestamp or independent preregistration claim is made.

registrationReference.creationRule: Create only after the dedicated freeze commit and before the evidence run. It contains that non-circular 40-hex commit identifier followed by a newline.

population: All 219 admitted direct SAT+MONO+NMP tie-lines in server/engine-framework/cel/data/multi-t-nmp-lle.json
representation: Standard Abrams-Prausnitz UNIQUAC with row-specific Original-UNIFAC R/Q and directed family-pair a+b/T intercepts plus shared source/target molecular-descriptor slopes
optimizerInitialization: fit-start.json; neutral all-zero vector only; optimizer convergence against admitted training remains mandatory

splits.rule: Remove the union before the sole fit; evaluate each frozen row exactly once nominally

metrics.topologyRecall: qualified predicted-two-phase count / measured two-phase holdout count
metrics.tieLineRmsd: sqrt(sum squared mole-fraction errors over both measured endpoints and active components / total number of those endpoint-component errors)

gates.thermodynamicQualification: Every held row must PASS refined TPD, multistart Gibbs decrease/minimization, conservation, isoactivity, ambiguity rejection, seed accounting, and independent final-phase checks; unavailable/nonconverged checks are FAIL

uncertaintyProtocol.method: Leading local-covariance eigenvector, plus/minus one local standard error capped to 25% of parameter-bound margin
uncertaintyProtocol.qualification: Nominal gates only; sensitivity flashes cannot rescue a nominal failure
